description: Recommended, negative and neutral counts per brand. THE DENOMINATOR IS `classified`, NOT `answers_naming_them`: the classifier abstains on listicle mentions where an engine named a brand without endorsing it, so classified is usually much smaller, and a share computed against mentions understates every brand. `recommended_share` is null below the sample floor, which means NOT ENOUGH CLASSIFIED MENTIONS and must never be rendered as 0%. There is no single sentiment score and you must not compute one. RULES: a null rate means NOT ENOUGH ANSWERS YET, never zero — never render it as 0%. Engines are reported separately and must never be averaged into one score.

brand.description: Which brand to report on, from list_brands. REQUIRED when the organisation has more than one brand: omitting it returns brand_required rather than guessing, because a silent default would file one customer's numbers under another's.
